text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W. These are the ones in the search results.

**Available in the US**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** It is Qi2.2 certified with up to 25W wireless charging and a 45W USB-C port. It is $79.99 on Amazon US and $59.99 on the Baseus site as a launch price. ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html))
  - Dealectric lists code **AM52** for $6 off, which brings it to $53.99 (tested 2026-10-25). Buy here: [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. Check the final price at checkout. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/))
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh, A110R):** It has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, an active cooling fan, 45W wired in and out, and a built-in stand and display. It is $109.99, but it is a pre-order that ships Oct. 21 to Nov. 9, 2026. It is for Apple devices and works with the iPhone 13 to 17 series, except the 16e. ([Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910))
- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank:** It was the first power bank to get official Qi2.2 certification, with 25W wireless charging. The press release said it would launch in Q3 2025 on UGREEN's site and Amazon. It did not give a price or product link, so check the current listing. ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html))
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank (10,000 mAh):** It is 13.8 mm thick and was previewed at CES 2026 with Qi2 25W, optimized for the iPhone 17 series. ESR says it is sold on Amazon and ESR's site, but the release gave no price or link. It also says "Qi2 25W" rather than explicitly "Qi2.2". ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html))

**Japan only**
- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K:** It is a 10,000 mAh model with Qi2.2 25W and a built-in 35W USB-C cable, sold in Japan for ¥8,980. ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html))

**Compatibility:** You only get the full 25W if your phone supports Qi2.2, such as the iPhone 17 series. Baseus also lists the iPhone 16 series and Pixel 10 Pro XL. Other phones will charge more slowly.

For the best balance of price and features, the Baseus PicoGo AM52 looks like the best value. If you want active cooling and don't mind waiting for the shipment, the Anker MagGo 2 Pro is the premium pick.
